description: List assets of a given type (Computer, Monitor, Printer, NetworkEquipment, Peripheral, Phone, Software, Rack, Enclosure), with location_name, state_name and user_name beside the IDs. Use glpi_search for filtered queries.

name: glpi_list_assets

format.description: 'markdown' when data holds the markdown rendering
